topic: BUILD: a calm 20-minute first look at one credit report from one bureau, circling anything that looks off
pillar: BUILD: the first-hour setup and slow foundations (list your accounts, pull your credit report, change passwords, list bills, a small cushion).
caption:
Your credit report is a list. You can read a list.

Pick one bureau, pull one report at annualcreditreport.com, and check the current rules while you are there.
Read it slowly with a pen nearby.
Circle anything you do not recognize, especially old shared accounts.
For bigger questions, a licensed professional can help with the details.

Save this for a quiet morning this weekend ☕
The Day Zero Workbook has a page for your report notes. Link in bio.

Day one counts.

General education, not financial advice.

slides.title: Twenty minutes with your credit report
slides.subtitle: A calm first look, one bureau at a time

slides.title: Why look at it now
slides.body: After a divorce, your name may still be on old cards or loans. Your credit report is the list lenders see. Looking at it shows you what is really there.

slides.title: What to have ready
items: A phone or a laptop and a quiet 20 minutes
Your one-page account list, if you made one
A pen and one sheet of paper
A safe folder to save the file in

slides.title: How to pull one report
items: Go to annualcreditreport.com and check the current rules
Pick one of the three credit bureaus to start
Answer the identity questions, then download
Save it with today's date in the file name

slides.title: What to look for
items: Shared accounts you still need to sort out
Names or addresses that look wrong
Late payments you want to ask about

slides.title: Circle it and close the laptop
slides.body: Circle anything that looks off and write one short note beside it. That is enough for today. For shared debt or legal questions, a licensed professional can help with the details.

slides.title: Keep this for a quiet morning
slides.body: Save this post for your twenty minutes. The Day Zero Workbook has a page for your report notes, if that helps. It is in my Stan store, link in bio. Day one counts.
